proof_obligations: V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) - substitute(A(x)*B(x)*A(x), {A: V, B: G0, x: p}) = 0
W(q)*H0(q)*W(q) - substitute(A(x)*B(x)*A(x), {A: W, B: H0, x: q}) = 0
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the identical multiplicative pattern: a first function of the variable, then a second function of the same variable, then the first function again. The only differences are the function names and variable labels, so a parameterized template is the minimal shared structure.
